== Biography ==
'''John Glasgow''' was born about 1810 or 1811 in County Antrim, Ireland. The estimate comes from his reported age of forty in the surviving 1851 census.<ref name="Census1851">National Archives of Ireland, ''Census of Ireland, 1851'', Glenleslie, Dunaghy parish, County Antrim, household 23, John Glasgow; [http://www.census.nationalarchives.ie/pages/1851/Antrim/Kilconway/Dunaghy/Glenleslie/23/ household page].</ref>

The return records John as a son of household head [[Glasgow-1367|Robert Glasgow]]. John was a labourer and was absent in America when the census was taken.<ref name="Census1851" /> This directly establishes Robert as his father.

Robert's wife [[Unknown-540856|Catherine]] was also in the household and reported a first marriage in 1803, before John's estimated birth. She is John's probable mother, but the census gives each relationship to the household head and does not expressly call Catherine his mother.<ref name="Census1851" />
